content: Ɗiyaraɗiig nǝ tlǝvuukwah kǝ sawariya tsa Yesu
Ghyǝnnga ba Yesu kǝ tagtǝr kwanahaan kǝ dǝgitah baɗǝmma, aiyama taa kǝ mbǝrzahaana,
“Am sǝrgasǝrǝg taakiya tǝmaa ba hǝnng bu kǝ Hwaɗaga Haarakǝsa Dzava Hǝnyaha, da vǝlǝvda dlaɓ nǝ Zǝra Uuda da hǝrtǝvǝta.”
Kaa dzahav kǝ maalah ma zhiila kǝsauufah ard tlǝvuukwah tǝghǝr kǝ uudaha ma vǝgya maal ba tingting ma zhiila kǝsauufah, kwa ɗahav dǝ Kayafa.
Kaa ba ɗiya sawariya viya Yesu kǝ iitǝr da gǝlagǝl kiyava tsǝgaan kǝ iitǝra.
Aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Ɓag yam bi sarta hwaɗag biya, haik kǝ ciya hǝnkal kǝ uudaha.”
Ɗiyavaraɗiig nǝ walla tǝrshǝn kǝ Yesu ma Bǝtani
Ma sartǝn ndza ma Bitani nǝ Yesu ma vǝgya Siman kwandza njakǝn vǝcca.
Kaa sagau nǝ uusiin da vak Yesu dǝ mǝrta kwa ɓagava dǝ akura onis, righarighan dǝ tǝrshǝn bǝtbǝt kwa ba pir ganan ɗiyarǝt dat ghǝr ma sartǝn ndza zaa dǝga zǝg nǝ iina.
Nǝghǝghara ba nǝ mbǝrzahǝn ǝndkwaha, kaa badzǝg kǝ ǝrviɗmahuɗatǝra, aiyam nǝ iitǝra ma taatakatǝra, “Badza ba dǝgiti nǝ wanna.
Maa vǝlavu nǝ tǝrshinna, maa tlavkǝnatlǝg nǝ kwaɓ ba ɗyaka maa vǝlavtǝrvǝlǝg kǝ talagaha.”
Sǝrghaakasǝrǝg tsau nǝ Yesu kǝ dǝgiti ar tag nǝ iitǝra aiyama taa kǝ iitǝra, “Aujilbǝg am gaghya uusǝn ǝndkwani? Abi dǝgit maraw wa ɓagwi nǝ iina.
Ba kǝlaa hǝnga am ba ǝmtaɗ dǝ talagaha, ǝn maay nai ǝmtaɗ dǝ kuram kǝlaa hǝnng biya.
Kwan kǝ tǝrshinǝn aa ɗaigǝt nǝ iin tǝ vǝgharna, aa ɓag kwakyarvad ɓadla hǝɗa kaiya.
Bak jiijiir wan tagkur naiya, baɗǝm nǝ vakavaki da tagav nǝ ǝlbǝg maraw ma duni baɗǝmma, da ba tagav nǝ dǝgiti ɓagaa nǝ uusǝn kiyava dzamgaana.”
Haighanthaig nǝ Yahuda kǝ vǝla Yesu
Kaa ba dagal kǝ pal ma mbǝrzah kǝlaawa tar buwna, kwa ɗahav dǝ Yahuda Iskariyuti, da vak maalah ma zhiila kǝsauufaha.
Aiyama, “Awam da vǝlgwa nǝ uuram, akwama vǝlankurvǝlǝgi?” Ar vǝlar kǝ sǝl kul hǝkǝrɗa.
Ciigǝt tǝ kwahiin kǝ sarta wa fǝgharzha nǝ iin kǝ gata ɗuul vǝltǝr Yesu.
Zuuzǝg Yesu kǝ dǝga zǝga Hwaɗaga Dzava Hǝnnyah ǝmtaɗ dǝ mbǝrzahaana

Daghuvala zǝngwa Hwaɗaga Haara kǝssa bǝruudi kwal yista, kaa sagau nǝ mbǝrzahaan da vak Yesu, am nǝ iitǝr taa kǝ iina, “Vaakwar wagha naag nǝng ma kǝmǝnda ɓadlkana kǝ dǝgazǝg Hwaɗaga Haara kǝssa dzava hǝnyah kiyava zǝgaan kǝskǝghi?”

Aiyama, “Damdǝg damma huɗa kǝsa da vak uuda nǝ iina, tagamartaga, ‘Daada tsaga dǝgiti, waa taakiya, ɓagaaɓag nǝ sart kwan da zǝg nai kǝ dǝga zǝga Hwaɗaga Haarakǝsa Dzava Hǝnyah ma vǝgyagh ǝmtaɗ dǝ mbǝrzahaara.’ ”
Kaa ɓagaan kǝ mbǝrzahaan bandkwa tagatǝr nǝ Yesu kǝ ɓagaana, kaa ɓadlnaɓadlǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ dǝga zǝga Hwaɗaga Haarakǝsa Dzava Hǝnyaha.
Ɓǝlaa ba hwaasa, ngal cihuran da za dǝga zǝga ǝmtaɗ dǝ mbǝrzahaan kǝlaawa tar buwa.
Ar tǝghǝrdǝga za dǝga zǝga, am nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Bak jiijiir wan tagkur naiya, palla ma kurama da vǝla kaiya.”
Kaa njitǝrnjiig ba vaivaiya, ar farzha kǝ ndavgarundavǝg ba da palla palla ar taakiya, “Kai ni, Yaazhigǝla?”
Kaa ngutǝranguga amaa, “Daddakwa za dǝga zǝg ǝmtaɗ dǝ kaiya ma kuwa, iin wa da vǝla kaiya.
Zǝra Uuda da ǝmtsǝg bandkwa vindava ma kakkaɗa Daadamazhigǝl tǝghǝr kǝ iina. Dǝga zhuwadaal kǝ daddakwa da vǝla Zǝra Uuda! Ngulǝn maa yava bi nǝ uuda nǝ iin biya.”
Aiyam nǝ Yahud kwa vǝlǝt Yesu na, “Kai ni, dadda tsaga dǝgita?” Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Kǝgh ndakwani taghǝdataga.”
Za Jibiya Yaazhigǝla
Ar tǝghǝrdǝga za dǝga zǝga, kaa kǝsgantkǝsǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ bǝruudiya, tagar kǝ uus kǝ Daadamazhigǝla, lahnan vǝltǝr kǝ mbǝrzahaana, amaa, “Namamma zamzǝga, kwana iin nǝ vǝghara.”
Kaa kǝsgantkǝsǝg kǝ iin kǝ kuwa yuwa inabiya, tagar kǝ uus kǝ Daadamazhigǝla, vǝltǝra amaa, “Hǝɓamhǝɓǝg baɗǝmaruwa.
Kwana iin nǝ avǝzara dǝga righa lanngiya kwa ɗiyavda mbakyarvad uudah baɗyaka, kiyava ɓǝsha haipahaatǝra.
Ən tagkurtaga, ǝn madlai da gwiya hǝɓa yuwa inabiyin biya, bamma daghuvali ǝn da hubǝg nai kǝ daalaan ǝmtaɗ dǝ kuram ma tlǝksǝra Daadara.”
Ɓǝlara ba Yesu ard mbǝrzahaan kǝ ǝngsa, kaa sagal kǝ iitǝra, ngal ba dagat kǝ iitǝr damma Aghwa kwa dǝ Uufaha Zaitun.
Da ɓala agajawa sǝrgabi kǝ Yesu nǝ Bitrusa
Am nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Bamma huɗa avǝɗna, baɗǝmaru am da mbǝɗǝg ma fadghǝraru am da ɗukusa, mbakyarvad dǝgiti da dzǝgaar dǝ kaiya, aɗaba ba vindavindan taakiya,
“Tǝhala kwama da ciyakutciig nǝ uud dǝ shiifǝga, ǝn da dǝgaa nai tǝghǝr kǝskuram damma Galili.”
Am nǝ Bitrus taa kǝ iina, “Aanji ar mbǝɗan ma fadghǝraatǝr baɗǝm mbakyarvad dǝgiti da dzǝgaar dǝ kǝgha, ǝn da maay nai biya.”
Am nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Bak jiir wan tagak naiya, bamma huɗa avǝɗna, lakuti wiig kǝ ghwatkala, agha da ɓagaan kǝ agajawa sǝrkwai shig hǝkǝrda.”
Aiyam nǝ Bitrus taa kǝ iina, “Aanji ǝn da ǝmtsǝg ǝmtaɗ dǝ kǝgha, ǝn da maay ɓagaan kǝ agajawa sǝra kǝgh biya.” Tagarar bandkwah dlaɓ nǝ mbǝrzah baɗǝmma.
Dzǝgwadzǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ zhigǝl ma Getsamani
Kaa dagal kǝ Yesu ard mbǝrzahaan damma Getsamani, aiymaa taa kǝ mbǝrzahaana, “Ndzamandzǝg vaakwana, ǝn dagal da dzǝgwazhigǝl vaakwaha.”
Kaa ba dagal kǝ iin dǝ Bitrus ard zarha Zabadi buwa, ngal mbǝkǝnmbǝga dlaɓa kaa badza ǝrviɗmahuud kǝ iina.
Amaa dlaɓ taa kǝ iitǝra, “Badzǝga ǝrvidmahuɗǝn ǝn dǝvakai naina, anǝgha ba tsakwitsǝga. Ndzamandzǝg vaakwana, uufamuufǝg ǝmtaɗ dǝ kaiya.”

Gavǝt ba nǝ iin dagal da tǝvuukw hǝɗiikǝna, ngal tsǝɗi kǝ iin kǝ ghǝraan damma haay dzǝgwa kǝ zhigǝla, amaa, “Daadara, akwama ɓagaaɓaga, kǝswaarakǝssǝg kǝ kwanǝn kuwa dlaɗa, bakǝvakwaha, gat bi kǝ dǝgiti ǝn naag nai biya, bamma dǝgiti agha naag nǝnnga.”
Sagha ba nǝ iin savak mbǝrzahaana, tlatǝra hǝna haara, amaa taa kǝ Bitrusa, “Mbats am uufǝgabi kǝ dǝga aau pal ǝmtaɗ dǝ kai biya.
Uufamuufǝga am dzǝgwaan dlaɓ kǝ zhigǝl haik dagau kǝskuram damma fǝshiga, shiɗǝkw naagaana, vǝgh wa ɗǝmɗǝma.”
Kaa gwiya dagal kǝ iin kǝ dǝga buwa, dzǝgwa kǝ zhigǝl amaa, “Daadara akwama da ghudkwaarabi nǝ wan kǝ dlaɗ bamma hǝɓanuuhǝɓǝga, aandzandzǝg bat naagagha.”
Gwiyaghǝra ba nǝ iin saasa, tlatǝra ba hǝna haara, Aɗaba haar wa ma gyiyaatǝra.
Kaa gwiya ɗutǝrǝsɗuug kǝ Yesu, ngal ba gwiya dagal da dzǝgwazhigǝl kǝ dǝga hǝkǝrɗa, kaa gwiya tagaan kǝ iin kǝ ǝlbǝgi tagada nǝ iin wura.
Kaa saas kǝ iin da vak mbǝrzahaan amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “Gwaastǝn am badlaɓ ba hǝnahaar am ɗiya kuɗga? Wa ɓagaaɓag ci nǝ sart kwada vǝlav nǝ Zǝra Uuda damma dǝv kǝ yaa dadda haipa.
Ciyamciiga, jiyam dagala. Wa sǝghaasǝg nǝ dadda vǝla kaiya.”
Viyavǝtviig Yesu

Ba ndzǝgaan Yesu ba taa ghaiya, ka sagau kǝ Yahuda pall ma kǝlaawa tar buwna, ǝmtaɗ dǝ dzahava dlamaa kǝlaaw baɗyak dǝ katsakarah ard dǝ zadaha, ɓǝlartǝr nǝ maalah ma zhiila kǝsauuf ard dǝ tlǝvuukwaha.
Aɗaba tagatǝrdatag daddakwa da vǝlgaanǝn kǝ dǝga sǝrgi da marg nǝ iin taakiya, “Dadda kwanda ɓǝrhug nai na, iin nǝ uuda nǝ iin viyamviiga.”
Bad saasaana, kaa dagau kǝ iin da tǝvǝgh kǝ Yesu amaa taa kǝ iina, “Uus, dadda tsaga dǝgita!” Kaa bǝrhugaan kǝ Yahuda.
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Tsaghwa, ɓag kǝ dǝgiti aa sǝkadsǝga.” Kaa sagau kǝ uudahiin, ar viyit kǝ Yesu ar hǝkynana.
Nǝghǝgha ba nǝ pal ma lii ǝmtaɗ dǝ Yesu ǝntkwaha, ngal tǝɗda kǝ katsakaraan ghudarda kǝ hyimmi kǝ kwatnaha maal ba tingting ma zhiila kǝsauufaha.
Am nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Gwidǝmgwiig kǝ katsakaragh damma kumbǝghaana, aɗaba baɗǝm daddakwa tǝɗda katsakara, da tsǝg ba katsakara.
Mam tlǝg nǝ uuram ǝn ɗahgant bi kǝ Daadar, tlǝgwadi ba watswats kǝ zarha ɓǝlg kwa juujig kǝ dakwala tlaujah kǝlaawa tar bu biya?
Ai ci tsaa, da righav ndandar wa tagada nǝ Əlbǝga Daadamazhigǝl vindavindan taaki ba pakat wanǝn kǝ dǝgit dzǝgardzǝgi?”

Ma kwahiin kǝ sarta amaa taa kǝ uudahiina, “Amaa sagau dǝ katsakarah ard dǝ zadah da viya kai bandgi ǝn dadda zaa ɗuula? Ba kǝla hǝnnga ǝn bamma gaagazaiya Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝl ǝn tsaga dǝgita, viyamkwa biya.
Baɗǝm wanahaan dzǝghaar ba kiyava righa dǝgiti vindara nǝ tlayanngah ma Əlbǝga Daadamazhigǝl vindavindana.” Cinngaraba nǝ mbǝzahaan kwanǝnna, kaa ta dagalaatǝr kǝ iitǝr baɗǝm ar ɗuwarsa.
Yesu tǝvuukwa lii ma gyiɗya
Kaa lanngaan kǝ lii viyarǝt Yesu dagal da vak Kayafa, zhiila kǝsauuf maamaala, vakavaki dzaharvǝt nǝ maalaha lii tsaga adzahadzah ard tlǝvuukwaha.
Kaa gatǝrgatǝg kǝ Bitrus mahal mahal ba bitky tangw dat ghaiya wakyagha zhiila kǝsauuf maamaala, kaa daas kǝ iin damma gaagazayan cihura ǝmtaɗ dǝ lii uufa wakyagh kiyava vaza dǝgiti da dzǝgardzǝga
Kaa ba gata shiidaha fiid kwada tagav tǝghǝr kǝ Yesu nǝ zhiila kǝsauufah maamaal ard lii ma gyiɗ baɗǝmma, kiyava tsǝgaan kǝ iitǝra.
Tlarkǝna biya, bakǝvakwaha mǝng nǝ kyalma uudah ba ɗyak sarǝv sa ɓa shiida fiida. Tǝhalakwaha kaa sagau kǝ uudah buwa
aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Kwan kǝ uuda wa taga taaki, ‘Ən dlagnadlag kǝ vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla, ǝn gwiya ndǝrǝt bamma hǝng hǝkǝrɗa.’ ”
Kaa ciig kǝ maal ba tingting ma zhiila kǝsauufaha, amaa taa kǝ Yesu, “Agha maay dǝ ǝlbǝg biya? Shiidǝn tag nǝ uudahaan tǝghǝr kǝskǝghǝnmi?”
Mbǝɗabi Yesu kǝ ghaiyaan biya. Aiyam maal ba tingting ma zhiila kǝssauufah taa kǝ iina, “Aɗabad Daadamazhigǝl kwad shifǝga, tagkǝmndtag akwama kǝgh Kǝristi, Zǝra Daadamazhigǝla.”
Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Band kwagha tagda nǝnnga. Ən tagkurtag baɗǝmma, ciigǝt ndakwana am da nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ Zǝra Uuda cihurgan tǝ dǝvaa kafa Dadda Ndzǝɗa, sii ma akumba zhigǝla.”

Kaa tahdatahǝg kǝ maal ba tingting ma zhiila kǝsauufah kǝ sǝɗavaan mbakyarvad badzǝga ǝrviɗmahuuɗ amaa, “Badzadabadzǝg kǝ ɗaaga Daadamazhigǝla! Kwar kaci kǝ shiid wa kiyam gwiya naag nǝmyami? Amaa cinngacinng aa badza ɗaaga Daadamazhigǝla.
Au wamaa nǝghǝga nǝ uurami?” Kaa ngugangug kǝ iitǝr taakiya, “Tlaltlǝg maa tsǝvana!”
Kaa tafgarvatafǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ ashaghwvai ma huɗvǝga, ar dlaghara kǝ tsǝga, ar ɓalara kǝ mahupennga,
ar taakiya, “Tagkǝmndtag kǝ tlayanngǝra, akwama ba kǝgh nǝ Kǝristiya, tag kǝ dadda kwa tsaktsǝga!”
Ɓalaaɓalǝg Bitrus kǝ agajawa sǝrgabi kǝ Yesu
Ma kwaniin kǝ sarta, ndza cihurgan ma gaagazaya hǝnnyahiina Bitrusa, kaa sagau nǝ dǝghwiin ɓatlǝr hǝnyahiin da vakaan amaa taa kǝ iina, “Abi ghǝravagh ndakwi agha ǝmtaɗ dǝ Yesu uuda Galilin!”
Kaa ɓala gajau kǝ Bitrus tǝvuukwatǝr baɗǝmma, amaa, “Ən sǝrgabi nai kǝ dǝgiti agha tag nǝng tǝghǝr biya.”
Saal ba nǝ iin samma bǝrcama, kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg nǝ dughwi tlǝrǝn kwa ɓa tlǝr ma hǝnyahiina, amaa taa kǝ lii ghacga vaakwahiina, “Kwanǝn kǝ uud araa ndzaa ǝmtaɗ dǝ Yesu uuda Nazarat!”
Kaa gwiya ɓala agajau kǝ Bitrus baz zaha ngwaɗǝg taakiya, “Ən sǝrga bi var kǝ uudanǝn biya.”
Tǝhala zǝlam ba hǝɗikǝna, kaa sagau kǝ lii ghacga vaakwahiin davak Bitrusa, am nǝ iitǝra, “Ba pakat kǝgh ndakwani agha pal nǝng ma iitǝr yaana. Ghayi agha tag nǝng wa markadamarǝga.”
Ngal farzha kǝ tlafa ghǝraana, ndaha ngwaɗǝga, taakiya, “Ən sǝrgai var kǝ uudanǝn biya.” Tǝhala kwaha kaa wiig kǝ ghwatkala.
Kaa dzamnadzamǝg Bitrus kǝ ǝlbǝgi tagghar Yesu taakiya, “Lakuti wiig nǝ ghwatkal hinana, agha da ɓagaan kǝ agajawa sǝrkwai shig hǝkǝrɗa.” Kaa dagal kǝ Bitrus da gyimal ngal tuug kǝ iin ba vaivaiya.
